title: Fractions, decimals and percents: cheat sheet

blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: Fractions, decimals and percents are three ways to write the same amount. $\frac{1}{4}=0.25=25\%$. Pick whichever form makes the job easiest.

blocks.title: Add fractions
blocks.body: $\frac{a}{b}+\frac{c}{d}=\frac{ad+cb}{bd}$ (use the LCM to keep numbers small)

blocks.title: Rounding and percents
items: 5 or more rounds up, 4 or less stays
Percent of a number: decimal times number

blocks.body: For 10% of a number, move the decimal point one place left. Build other percents from it.
